title: Distinct Pieces
statement: A music app shows every distinct non-empty run of consecutive letters (substring) of a song's code name. Return how many distinct substrings the name has.

answerKey.pattern: Insert every suffix into a trie; each new node is one new distinct substring
keyPoints: Every substring is a prefix of some suffix
Insert all suffixes; count nodes created (excluding the root)
Repeated substrings walk existing nodes and add nothing
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Put every substring in a hash set: O(n³) time for hashing strings

hints: How are substrings related to suffixes?
Each substring is the start of some suffix.
Insert the n suffixes into one trie and count the nodes it creates.
